audience: developers who build semantic search and retrieval on Voyage AI embeddings and reranking

useCases.title: Embed documents for search
useCases.text: Turn up to 128 texts into embedding vectors. Set the input type to document for texts you will search later. Embeddings are billed by tokens on your Voyage account.

useCases.title: Rerank search results against a question
useCases.text: Score up to 1000 documents against a query and return them ordered by relevance. Use it on the results of a first search.

useCases.title: Review Batch API jobs
useCases.text: List the Batch API jobs with their status and request counts. Open one to read its output file IDs.

useCases.title: Cancel a stuck batch job
useCases.text: Cancel a batch job that is validating or in progress. It moves to cancelling for up to 10 minutes, then to cancelled.
